name: Piecewise Linear Opacity Approximation
definition: A volume rendering technique that approximates opacity using piecewise linear functions instead of piecewise constant, handling arbitrarily small opacity (e.g., 1e-6) but not coordinates with exactly zero opacity.
summary: Piecewise Linear Opacity Approximation improves volume rendering stability by approximating accumulated opacity linearly between samples, unlike the standard piecewise constant assumption.
